entities.summary: Nathan Perkovich is a Croatian-American former professional ice hockey player. He was selected by the New Jersey Devils in the 8th round of the 2004 NHL Entry Draft. In 2015, Perkovich played for the Croatian national team at the IIHF World Championship Division I.
